title: AgentDocker Agentfile
description: Several agents described together and started with `agentdocker up`. Put `#:schema <this file's URL>` on the first line of an Agentfile.toml for completion and checking in a TOML editor. `agentdocker agentfile check` reads a file the way `up` will.

version.description: The Agentfile format version. Absent means 1, the format before versions. Version 2 adds the launch fields (prompt, effort, args, config, idle_messages, coordinate) and expands ${VAR}; `agentdocker agentfile upgrade` rewrites a version 1 file.

name.description: Team name: every agent gets the label team=<name>.

agents.description: The agents, by name, started in the order written (dependencies first).

expandable.description: From version 2, ${VAR}, ${VAR:-default}, ${VAR-default}, ${VAR:?message} and ${VAR?message} are expanded from the environment, and $$ is one dollar sign; any other $ is an error.

runtime.description: What hosts the agent. Commands can be built (from prompt, model, effort) for claude-code, codex, docker-agent and gemini-cli; any other runtime needs `command`.

provider.description: The model provider, a label for `ps`.

model.description: The model. Passed to the runtime when agentdocker builds the command; a label for `ps` on a written command.

command.description: The command line, launched as written. Required in version 1; from version 2 it may be left out for a runtime agentdocker can build a command for, and then must be.

workdir.description: Where the agent runs; relative to the Agentfile's directory.

isolate.description: Give the agent its own linked worktree and branch.

tty.description: Give the agent a terminal rather than pipes, for an interactive runtime; `agentdocker attach` reaches it.

restore.description: Bring the agent back under the same identity when agentd restarts.

in_pane.description: Run the agent in a tmux pane, reachable with `tmux attach`.

restart.description: When to start it again after it exits.

depends_on.description: Agents in this file that must be running before this one starts.

prompt.description: Version 2. The first instruction, for a command agentdocker builds. Without a terminal (tty, in_pane) it is required.

effort.description: Version 2. Reasoning effort in the runtime's words: claude-code low, medium, high, xhigh, max; codex minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh.

args.description: Version 2. Provider arguments added to a built command, before the prompt.

config.description: Version 2, docker-agent only. The agent's YAML file (relative to the Agentfile) or its registry reference.

idle_messages.description: Version 2. Let a message start a turn while the session is idle: Claude Code's channel (interactive sessions; Claude's consent applies) or Codex's input adapter. Experimental.

coordinate.description: Version 2. Wire AgentDocker into a built command: the MCP server (and, for Claude Code, the hooks) unless the runtime's own configuration already has them.
